summary.text: 将严格质量路由绑定到 Work Item Contract 的 base/current 文件证据：只有非发布工作流中恰好一行从一个 40 位 action SHA 替换为另一个 40 位 SHA 时，才投影为 targeted strict；生成的生命周期记录不再作为风险路径重复升级。所有其他形状继续走完整 strict 质量检查。

Base/current evidence binding and generated projection exclusion
Finish-side routing uses the same evidence-bound classifier

mechanism.text: 路由器先读取 Contract baseCommit 对应的工作流文件和当前文件，使用精确的一行替换判定；Finish 与 governance profile 两条入口共享同一判定器。任务状态、报告和 Outcome 等生成投影只参与证据记录，不参与严格风险路径选择。

evidence.subject: Exact SHA-only and fail-closed negative cases
Finish routing evidence binding and unavailable-evidence behavior

affectedComponents.detail: Exact immutable workflow pin updates use quality-strict-targeted with quality-fast only; unsafe or high-risk shapes remain quality-full.
Routing facts include the evidence-bound immutablePinChange classification without exposing file contents.
Generated lifecycle projections are excluded from quality risk paths and Finish binds the classifier to the Contract base.

designDecisions.decision: Fail closed for every shape other than one exact immutable SHA replacement.
designDecisions.reason: A routing optimization must not lower proof requirements for action identity, mutable references, extra changes, or release/signing workflows.

designDecisions.decision: Use repository evidence rather than path names or self-declared intent.
designDecisions.reason: The same rule must be trustworthy in both automatic profile selection and final Finish routing.

technicalDetails.detail: Both routing callers read the Contract baseCommit and current workflow bytes before accepting the targeted route; unavailable evidence produces an ineligible classification.
Lifecycle status, Outcome, start, and Human Benefit Report files remain auditable outputs but are excluded from strict quality risk-path selection.

evidence.claim: The routing implementation and its real-sample behavior are covered by the evidence-bound classifier, governance integration test, and Finish integration test.
